standard_prerequisites.name: The translation of morphisms of dotted arrows for the diagonal into pairs of dotted arrows for the morphism
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof (source lines 9609-9618)
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the two formulations of uniqueness.

core_obligations: Reformulate via the diagonal: the uniqueness clause for the morphism is stated for dotted arrows, and a morphism of dotted arrows for the diagonal amounts to a pair of dotted arrows for the morphism (proof lines 9594-9610)

Equivalence: uniqueness for the morphism therefore holds exactly when every dotted arrow for the diagonal is unique, which is separatedness of the diagonal by the valuative criterion for separatedness (proof lines 9611-9619)
proof_roadmap: 把唯一性表述成对点箭头的要求。
对角线的一条点箭头 ↔ 原态射的一对点箭头 ⇒ 原态射的唯一性 ⟺ 对角线的点箭头唯一。
由分离性的赋值判据，后者即 Δ 分离。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that uniqueness in the valuative criterion for a morphism of algebraic stacks is equivalent to separatedness of its diagonal (author lemma at source lines 9586-9592, label lemma-uniqueness-and-diagonal). The proof (source lines 9594-9620) identifies a morphism of dotted arrows for the diagonal with a pair of dotted arrows for the morphism and applies the valuative criterion for separatedness (proof lines 9594-9619). The identification of the two formulations of uniqueness is the substance. H3.
